questions.topic: future Git, release and deployment authority

options.label: Exact-action approvals
options.decision: Keep commit, push, merge, release and deploy unauthorized by default. A later planning commit, push, canonical Actionplan write-back, release or deploy each requires its own exact target/action approval.

options.label: Allow future local planning commits
options.decision: After required checks pass, Codex may make local planning-only commits in `metaframer-kernel`; push/merge/release/deploy and Actionplan write-back still require separate exact approval.

questions.whyHuman: These actions create durable or external state and this turn explicitly forbids them.

selections.effect: The standalone `metaframer-net/metaframer-kernel` repository becomes the future owner of kernel runtime and public kernel contracts only after every canonical KGA decision is closed. Actionplan remains the governance owner and the platform monorepo remains the implementation workspace until that gate passes.
Clean start with provenance. No platform history is copied, filtered, mirrored or extracted; authorized kernel packages may only be created here after the gate, tracked by a provenance ledger.
All 33 pending module parents are explicitly deferred as non-code-bearing for this bootstrap. No descendant is invented; each later descendant needs its own exact human-approved ledger row.

All 13 ghost identities are rejected as WBS identities. No node or alias is created, execution references stay removed or disabled, and each directive document remains non-executable requirements evidence.

Every colliding short ADR ID is quarantined and deprecated and is forbidden as an approvalRef. A later authorized canonical write-back allocates unique registry IDs per topic and migrates consumers atomically.

Fixed shared-schema topology with a `tenant_id` discriminator and deny-by-default PostgreSQL RLS. The threshold disposition is not-applicable-fixed-topology and no automatic promotion exists; any dedicated isolation exception is a new human-approved topology decision.

No standing mutation permission is created. Commit, push, merge, release, deploy and Actionplan write-back remain default-deny and each later action needs its own exact target approval. The `currentTurn` booleans on the A01 question record the standing default at request time. A separate later exact user instruction, recorded in `oneShotGitAuthorization`, grants Codex exactly one normal non-force, no-tag commit and push of this exact planning package to `agent/kernel-control-plane-reconcile` from expected base 90e5f6ac2b8beb4d8be1064390ba433b2bbdd434; it is not reusable, does not apply to main, does not extend to Claude and leaves pull-request creation, merge, release, deploy, Actionplan write-back and runtime unauthorized. Its remaining consumability is proven by remote-ref absence before the push, not by the committed consumptionStatus field.

oneShotGitAuthorization.action: one normal commit and push of this exact planning package
oneShotGitAuthorization.consumptionRule: Consumed by the first successful normal non-force push of this exact planning package to refs/heads/agent/kernel-control-plane-reconcile. Consumption is fenced by remote-ref state, not by the committed consumptionStatus field. Once consumed the grant is spent; any further commit, push, re-push, amended push, force push or push to any other ref requires a new exact human approval.
oneShotGitAuthorization.prePushRule: Before the authorized push, `git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/agent/kernel-control-plane-reconcile` MUST return no matching ref and no output. If that ref exists at any SHA the grant is already spent: stop immediately and perform no push, re-push, amend or force. Only empty output proves the grant is still unconsumed.
oneShotGitAuthorization.evidenceRule: Consumption is evidenced by the remote branch refs/heads/agent/kernel-control-plane-reconcile existing with a tip SHA that is a descendant of expected base 90e5f6ac2b8beb4d8be1064390ba433b2bbdd434. A non-descendant tip, a force push, a pushed tag, a push to main or a push to any other branch is outside this grant.
oneShotGitAuthorization.postPushEvidenceRule: After the authorized push the remote ref refs/heads/agent/kernel-control-plane-reconcile must equal the local commit and must descend from expected base 90e5f6ac2b8beb4d8be1064390ba433b2bbdd434. Remote state, not the committed field, remains authoritative.
oneShotGitAuthorization.consumptionStatusNote: The committed consumptionStatus is deliberately not mutated after the push, so it is snapshot evidence only and is never sufficient authority after publication. A later checkout must resolve consumption from remote-ref state through prePushVerificationCommand.
oneShotGitAuthorization.note: This grant is one-shot and branch-scoped. It never becomes standing authority, never applies to main, and never converts an approval into runtime, release or Actionplan write-back authority.
